## State hiện tại: delivery_ready (pre-task)

### Entry criteria
- [x] Initialization hoàn tất → `CURRENT_INITIALIZATION_STATE.md` = `delivery_ready`
- [x] Toolkit generated + validated
- [x] Blueprint approved (2026-07-14)

### Execute (chờ first delivery task)
- [ ] Task/ticket đầu tiên được tạo (AC testable, priority, dependencies)
- [ ] Hoặc tiếp tục greenfield Architecture (state 2) — `create-solution-design`, `research-implementation`

### Research
- Research mandatory khi vào developer state 2–3 hoặc greenfield state 2.

### Engineering Knowledge
- Standards sẽ load theo state (xem `workflow-profile.md` "Engineering Knowledge per state").

### Exit criteria (to advance → first task)
- [ ] Definition of Ready met cho ít nhất 1 task
- [ ] First task registered trong PM system + spec/mini-spec attached

### Next state
→ Developer **state 1 (Task Created)** *hoặc* greenfield **state 2 (Architecture)**

## Template — Developer state checklist (dùng cho mỗi task)

### State 1: Task Created
- [ ] Entry: ticket created; spec/mini-spec attached
- [ ] Execute: `analyze-ticket` → risks/affected areas; `estimate-feature`
- [ ] Exit: AC testable; priority assigned; dependencies identified
- [ ] Memory: `NEXT_TASK.md` updated · Evidence: ticket link
- [ ] Validation: Definition of Ready met
- → Next: **Ready For Analysis**

### State 2: Ready For Analysis
- [ ] Entry: Task Created passed DoR
- [ ] Execute: `analyze-ticket`, `estimate-feature`
- [ ] Exit: analysis complete; risks identified; escalation decided (Tier 2 areas: payment/checkout/address/DB)
- [ ] Memory: `RESEARCH_NOTES.md` (initial unknowns)
- → Next: **Researching**

### State 3: Researching
- [ ] Entry: analysis complete; research trigger assessed
- [ ] Execute: `research-implementation` (Magento + Hyvä profile — `../research/research-profile.md`)
- [ ] Exit: stop condition met (8 điều kiện — `../research/research-checklist.md`)
- [ ] Memory: `RESEARCH_NOTES.md` entry · all findings classified `[VERIFIED]`/`[ASSUMPTION]`/`[EXTERNAL: verify]`/`[UNKNOWN]`
- → Next: **Planning**

### State 4: Planning
- [ ] Entry: research stop condition met
- [ ] Execute: `create-solution-design`, `split-feature-into-tasks`
- [ ] Exit: plan TL-reviewed (Mode A)
- [ ] Decision gate: `plan-approval` (TL, level 2) — pause until approved
- → Next: **Implementing**

### State 5: Implementing
- [ ] Entry: plan approved; engineering standards loaded
- [ ] Execute: `implement-task`, `fix-bug`, `refactor-code`, `generate-unit-test`
- [ ] Exit: code matches plan; no scope creep; self-validation done
- [ ] Localization: storefront string có ở cả `vi_VN.csv` + `en_US.csv`
- → Next: **Self Review**

### State 6: Self Review
- [ ] Entry: implementation complete
- [ ] Execute: `review-code`, `generate-test-cases`, `prepare-pr`
- [ ] Exit: AI pre-review PASS / PASS WITH WARNINGS (no NEEDS FIX)
- [ ] Evidence: `.ai/evidence/{task}/pre-review.md` + `test-result.md`
- [ ] Business rules (02) respected; high-risk (§12) checked
- → Next: **Waiting Review**

### State 7: Waiting Review
- [ ] Entry: Self Review passed
- [ ] Execute: TL runs `review-code`
- [ ] Exit: TL approved OR change requests issued
- [ ] Decision gate: `code-approval` (TL, level 2)
- → Next: **Ready For QC** (hoặc **Fix Review** nếu change requests)

### State 8: Fix Review (conditional)
- [ ] Entry: TL issued change requests
- [ ] Execute: `implement-task`, `fix-bug`, `review-code`
- [ ] Exit: fixes applied; self review re-run PASS
- → Next: **Waiting Review**

### State 9: Ready For QC
- [ ] Entry: TL approved
- [ ] Execute: `generate-test-cases`, `prepare-qc-handoff`
- [ ] Exit: QC signoff OR bugs found (→ Fix Review)
- [ ] Decision gate: `qc-signoff` (PM/TL, level 2)
- [ ] Evidence: `.ai/evidence/{task}/qa-signoff.md` or bug reports
- → Next: **Done**

### State 10: Done
- [ ] Entry: QC signoff (Mode A)
- [ ] Execute: `compact-context`, `record-decision`, `record-risk`, `record-lesson`, `summarize-progress`
- [ ] Exit: DoD met; evidence complete; estimation logged; context/memory updated
- → Terminal — transition to next task

### Blocked?
Nếu bất kỳ exit ✗ → blocked; note thiếu gì (link tới DEC-ID hoặc missing input) trong `.ai/runtime/workflow/CURRENT_WORKFLOW_STATE.md`.
